steps.title: 🤝 Collaborate with your team
steps.description:
Invite teammates with the right level of access:

- **Viewer** — see configs and audit log, can't change anything
- **Editor** — create/edit configs, segments, targeting rules
- **Admin** — full control: environments, API keys, team, webhooks

> Give your PM *viewer* access, your backend engineer *editor*.

steps.title: Open Team settings
steps.description: Click **Team** to manage members and invites.
